Inspect cached API responses

Source: R/cache.R
ccld_cache_info.Rd

Returns one row per cached response. Cache entries older than getOption("ccldr.cache_ttl_seconds") are ignored by API helpers, but they can still appear here until the cache is cleared.

Usage

ccld_cache_info()

Value

A tibble with one row per cached response and columns key, age_seconds, and size_bytes.

See also

Other cache management: ccld_cache_clear()

Examples

ccld_cache_info()
#> # A tibble: 0 × 3
#> # ℹ 3 variables: key <chr>, age_seconds <dbl>, size_bytes <dbl>
